title: code_pointer rejects a valid path whose first segment ends in a host-like tail, such as Contoso.Web.App/Program.cs#Main
goal: kbfacts.code_pointer returns the pointer for Contoso.Web.App/Program.cs#Main, Foo.Net/Bar.cs#X and README.org#x and refuses only a scheme-less URL shape (a first segment followed by /blob/, /tree/, /-/ or /raw/) and a prose pair, with a test named code_pointer_valid_lookalikes that plants those valid look-alikes beside the rejected shapes

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts as k;sys.exit(0 if k.code_pointer({'note':'Contoso.Web.App/Program.cs#Main'}) else 1)
